description: This file defines the 'Log' class, which provides a wrapper around Android's native logging utilities. It manages log levels, facilitates chaining of LogNode instances for custom log handling, and offers various static methods for logging at different levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT).

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate logging through a chain of LogNode instances, providing static methods to log messages at various levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain where logs are sent.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode instance to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, optionally with an exception.
